question: Why are ferromagnetic materials strongly attracted by a magnet, whereas paramagnetic materials are only weakly attracted? Give reason.

options.A: Ferromagnetic materials have domains in which atomic magnetic moments are aligned. In an external field, many domains align with the field and produce strong magnetisation. Paramagnetic materials show only weak alignment of individual moments because thermal agitation opposes it; hence their attraction is weak.
options.B: Paramagnetic materials are strongly attracted because they possess permanently aligned domains, whereas ferromagnetic materials have only weak induced moments.
options.C: Ferromagnetic materials are strongly attracted because their induced magnetic moments oppose the external field, whereas paramagnetic moments vanish in a field.
options.D: Both ferromagnetic and paramagnetic materials are equally strongly attracted because both have the same magnetic susceptibility.
